title: DocxAnnotations
description: Layout annotation overlay for a DocxAST. Keyed by block path — does NOT modify the AST.

document_type.description: Inferred document category — used for renderer heuristics

annotations.description: Map of block path → annotation. Key format: 's{section_index}:b{block_index}' (e.g. 's0:b3' = section 0, block 3).

BlockAnnotation.description: Presentation hints for a single top-level block. All fields are optional.

heading_weight.description: Override the rendered heading level (h1–h6). Has no effect on tables.

spacing_before.description: Extra visual space injected above the block (overrides paragraph native spacing)

spacing_after.description: Extra visual space injected below the block

emphasis.description: Visual prominence. high = blue left-border + tint; medium = grey left-border; low = reduced opacity

image_display.description: Layout hint for a paragraph that contains an image

suppress.description: True to de-emphasize this block (e.g. decorative empty paragraphs, repeated spacers)

group_role.description: Role this block plays within its group
